about: The airframe's hull as the air sees it (p7c-wind design 12): the closed parts of assets-src/drone/drone.json whose union the boundary-element tool (tools/hullmass) takes, with the canister's cone and nozzle; the arms, motors, props, legs, skids, clamps and T-joints stand apart (thin members, each its own drag). Run: dotnet run -c Release --project tools/hullmass

tails.note: aft of the canister's body along its axis (drone.json's canister notes): the cone from the Ø0.101 m body to a Ø24 mm collar over 0.047 m, then the aluminium nozzle, Ø18 mm over 0.070 m, its further 12.5° bend at the collar left out (assumed: 0.3 % of the hull's volume)
